Definition: a wardrobe (i.e. room where clothing is spread)
BiblicalUsage: Meltachah is the vestry, the wardrobe room where the vestments were kept. 2 Kings 10:22 has Jehu call for the man over the vestry to bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal, so that every one of them could be dressed for his own destruction.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the vestry shows how religion can dress itself up for judgment: Baal's worshippers came in their robes and never left.
